The '''''Birthright''''' was a modified [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class freighter]] that was purchased by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Thes Cilgris]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was later flown by Thes' son [[Yett Cilgris]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and around the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the ''Birthright'' was operated by Thes' nephew [[Naul Cilgris]].
